name: Letrozole (aromatase inhibitor, endocrine therapy)
cyclesNote: continuous daily oral dosing; a 28-day cycle is only an accounting window. Continue while disease is controlled; physician determined.

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Confirm postmenopausal status (or ovarian suppression) before an aromatase inhibitor.
Ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D; assess bone health.
Avoid estrogen replacement in hormone-driven uterine tumors.
monitoring: Bone-mineral density periodically given long-term estrogen deprivation.
Lipids and symptom review (arthralgia, hot flashes).
Response assessment by imaging every few months given the indolent setting.

drugs.name: Letrozole
drugs.notes: Letrozole 2.5 mg by mouth once daily, taken continuously. Non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor used as endocrine therapy for hormone-receptor-positive, low-grade uterine disease (low-grade endometrial stromal sarcoma and indolent ER/PR-positive recurrent endometrial carcinoma). A progestin (e.g. megestrol) or tamoxifen are accepted alternatives where an aromatase inhibitor is unsuitable. Flat daily dose so the engine does not scale by body size. Author's own wording; general reference NCCN / DeVita.
